headline: Twamev Construction promoter group sells shares
hook: Promoter group entity sells stake in TICL
summary: Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited has notified the NSE regarding a share sale transaction. The sale was executed by Upendra Singh Constructions Co Pvt Ltd, a member of the company's promoter group. The disclosure follows standard regulatory requirements for promoter group shareholding changes.
why_it_matters: Promoter stake sales can signal liquidity needs or reduced confidence.
